reviews.review:
Unfortunately, I would not recommend this one at it's current price. I played the demo and really loved the world building, music, and visuals, but the gameplay was really lacking. 

Even though the gameplay was non-existent, I was excited to see how the story would unfold and the horrors that await. Sadly, after beating the whole game, my feelings did not change. The game relies heavily on the admittedly gorgeous visuals, but misses the mark completely on the horror aspect and gameplay. 

I couldn't put the game down because the story was so interesting and I constantly wanted to see more about this world. Upon beating the game, I feel even more confused and very disappointed with the ending .

The stealth sections are also probably the worst I've seen in a game in a while. You can stand beside most enemies and they won't notice you, or if they do, you can duck under a desk and they immediately forget about you. You can honestly sprint through all the stealth sections no problem.

TLDR; While I did enjoy the visuals and music, the game felt unsatisfying with minimal "scares". I recommend getting this at a much cheaper price than the $35.
